title: post task with valid absolute date
description: Test creating a task with a valid absolute due_date string to ensure the task is created successfully and a task ID is returned.

title: post task with empty title
description: Test creating a task with an empty title field to verify that the API returns a 400 validation error indicating that the title is required.

title: post task with relative due date
description: Test creating a task with a relative due_date string (e.g., next Wednesday) to verify that the task is created and the due_date is parsed correctly or errors are surfaced if parsing fails.

title: post calendar event with valid iso date
description: Test creating a calendar event with a valid ISO date string to ensure the event is created successfully and an event ID is returned.

title: post calendar event with ambiguous date string
description: Test creating a calendar event with an ambiguous date string (e.g., next month on 31st) to verify that the API returns a 400 parsing error indicating the date is ambiguous.

title: post calendar event with relative date crossing month boundary
description: Test creating a calendar event with a relative date string that crosses a month boundary (e.g., next Wednesday) to verify that the date is parsed and normalized correctly or errors are detected if the stored date is incorrect.
